Summary: Milestone 1: Initial Release - Core GC Analyzer
Description: Initial commit establishing GC Analyzer: baseline fleet monitoring app with performance and logo optimizations. Commit: d13dade.

Stabilization pass on fleet health evaluation and local tooling: fixed baseline health fallback edge cases, captured SSH stderr for permission issues, and made start-local.command robust across Python 3.10+ interpreters. Commits: c08a00d, 58da8b0, 367a350, 17c4eb6.

Introduced manage-app.sh for start/stop/status/restart/logs lifecycle control, consolidated app controls, fixed launcher bash array bug, and added demo cluster YAML stubs plus cluster save/collect UX with cancellable background jobs. Commits: 5e8df7e, 1c22ced, e30b0ce, 71af65e, 3bf6e1a.

Built incremental ingest with job progress tracking, concurrency locks, parallel ingestion, tabbed logs modal, cluster reconcile logic, trend backfill from GC logs, onboarded cluster ID fixes, and demo data survival / Full GC parsing fixes. Commits: 2f686fc, 3408e12, 1539168, 41f0eed.
Simplified demo fleet to two clusters, added node deep-dive analytics, and fixed line chart rendering for single-data-point series. Commits: 0f3c6c7, 45d96d5.
Added the ML tech preview dashboard surfacing predictive/experimental analytics views. Commit: 281bce9.

Summary: Milestone 7: SAR Host-Metrics Ingest & GC Correlation
